optimized_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ss.ss_store_sk,
    sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS day_diff
  FROM date_dim d2
  JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
   AND d2.d_year = 2001
   AND d2.d_moy = 8
  JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
   AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
)
SELECT
  s.s_store_name,
  s.s_company_id,
  s.s_street_number,
  s.s_street_name,
  s.s_street_type,
  s.s_suite_number,
  s.s_city,
  s.s_county,
  s.s_state,
  s.s_zip,
  sum(case when base.day_diff <= 30 then 1 else 0 end) as "30 days",
  sum(case when base.day_diff > 30 and base.day_diff <= 60 then 1 else 0 end) as "31-60 days",
  sum(case when base.day_diff > 60 and base.day_diff <= 90 then 1 else 0 end) as "61-90 days",
  sum(case when base.day_diff > 90 and base.day_diff <= 120 then 1 else 0 end) as "91-120 days",
  sum(case when base.day_diff > 120 then 1 else 0 end) as ">120 days"
FROM base
JOIN store s
  ON base.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
GROUP BY
  s.s_store_name,
  s.s_company_id,
  s.s_street_number,
  s.s_street_name,
  s.s_street_type,
  s.s_suite_number,
  s.s_city,
  s.s_county,
  s.s_state,
  s.s_zip
ORDER BY
  s.s_store_name,
  s.s_company_id,
  s.s_street_number,
  s.s_street_name,
  s.s_street_type,
  s.s_suite_number,
  s.s_city,
  s.s_county,
  s.s_state,
  s.s_zip
LIMIT 100
